authorization: Current broker policy; declarations do not grant permission.

commands.description: Open a URL in this chat's app-owned Gyro Browser, in the background by default. Prefer gyro_web_fetch for reading or summarizing a link; use the browser when rendered content, interaction, or visual evidence is needed. Set reveal: true only when the user explicitly asks to see the page or a required manual handoff such as sign-in needs it. Keep implementation checks, interactions, and screenshots in the background. Use this—not OS-level computer control—when the user asks for Gyro's in-app or embedded browser. Any http(s) origin is allowed; navigation is gated by project policy (Ask by default) and remembered per origin for the session.

reveal.description: Show the Browser panel only when the user explicitly asks to see the page or a required manual handoff such as sign-in needs it. Omit or set false for reading, research, implementation checks, interactions, screenshots, or rendering fallback; these work while hidden.

commands.description: Set this chat's existing Browser layout without changing panel width or reloading the page. Auto uses Desktop fit for loopback previews and Responsive for ordinary websites. Desktop (1280×800), Tablet (768×1024), and Mobile (390×844) fit inside the panel. Manual choices persist across navigation; Auto restores automatic behavior. Optional width/height customize a fixed layout in CSS pixels. Screenshots stay full resolution and mouse coordinates stay CSS pixels. Re-observe after changing the viewport.

width.description: Fixed layout width in CSS pixels.

height.description: Fixed layout height in CSS pixels.

workflowNote: Illustrative browser interaction fixture, not the default for reading links. Prefer gyro_web_fetch for text-only research; reveal the browser only when the user explicitly asks to see the page or a required manual handoff needs it. Implementation checks, interactions, and screenshots stay hidden. Use the user's URL and observed references. Plan mode permits only operations allowed by its read-only policy.
